source: Curated by daily scheduled task. Hero + new_this_week + critics drawn from verified streaming launches on Jonathan's platforms (Netflix, Apple TV+, Prime Video, Crunchyroll). Excludes watched.json + not-interested.json titles.

hero.title: Your Friends & Neighbors — Series Finale (S2 Ep 10 'The Night of the Hunter')
hero.format: Season finale (weekly drop, S2 complete; renewed for S3)
hero.about: Country-club Father's Day brunch turns into the season's reckoning — Hamm's Coop has been circling Owen Ashe all season and the finale puts every long-running thread on the table at once.
hero.why: You watched Ep 9 last week and pinned the finale on your watchlist — it dropped Friday 6/5 on Apple TV+. Witty, sour, ensemble-driven, ~50-min runtime: exactly your before-bed sweet spot. (Tier 2 hero: watchlist title that just became streamable.)

new_this_week.title: Your Friends & Neighbors — Series Finale (S2 Ep 10)
new_this_week.about: Season-closing brunch goes off the rails.

new_this_week.title: Cape Fear — Ep 3
new_this_week.about: Max Cady returns to torment the family that put him away — Bardem in slow-burn menace mode, Amy Adams as the lawyer in his crosshairs.
new_this_week.why: Horror/suspense + prestige cast + dread-tone — your wheelhouse. Catch Eps 1–2 first if you missed last Friday's drop.

new_this_week.title: Widow's Bay — Ep 9
new_this_week.about: Penultimate episode before next week's finale — the coven's slow-cooker plotting comes to a boil.
new_this_week.why: Already on your watchlist and you're current through Ep 7. Cozy supernatural-comedy that lands the off-beat tone you like.

new_this_week.title: Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed — Ep 5
new_this_week.about: Maslany's divorced fact-checker keeps tripping deeper into a web of murder, blackmail, and parental politics.
new_this_week.why: 30-min dark comedy — your bedtime format. You rated 'Chunnel' (Ep 3) already; pick up at Ep 4 if you missed last week.

new_this_week.title: Resident Alien — Final Season (S4, all 10 eps)
new_this_week.about: Tudyk's alien-as-doctor wraps up the series with the small-town gang in one final mess.
new_this_week.why: Sci-Fi-comedy combo, dry humor, complete season binge — full-drop is friendly to 1–2 hr/night pacing.

new_this_week.title: Office Romance
new_this_week.about: JLo as a workaholic airline CEO; Brett Goldstein as the in-house lawyer she's not supposed to fall for.
new_this_week.why: Goldstein co-wrote it — there's the dry humor hook. RT 48%, but the audience response is warmer. Worth a try if you want something light.

new_this_week.title: The Witness
new_this_week.about: Dramatization of the Rachel Nickell case and the deeply flawed police investigation around it.
new_this_week.why: British, character-driven, real-event suspense — checks several of your boxes. Heavier than your usual bedtime fare; flag as a weekend pick.

new_this_week.title: The Legend of Vox Machina — S4 Eps 4–6
new_this_week.format: Weekly (Wed) — 3 eps/wk, S4 is 12 eps total
new_this_week.about: A year after the Chroma Conclave, Vox Machina is split — the new arc starts pulling them back together.
new_this_week.why: Animated fantasy with sarcastic ensemble banter — straight match for your taste. Eps 1–3 dropped 6/3.

new_this_week.title: Clarkson's Farm — S5
new_this_week.about: Jeremy's on doctor-ordered light duty; Easy Care sheep arrive to save the day (they will not).
new_this_week.why: British dry humor — your kind of thing. Reviews are 3-star, but the bedtime rhythm holds.

new_this_week.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
new_this_week.format: 12 mini-episodes (early pre-release; full simulcast in July)
new_this_week.about: An overworked office drone and the convenience-store clerk he meets out back share cigarettes and quiet conversation.
new_this_week.why: Off-beat, adult-skewed, quiet humor with substance underneath — perfect 5/5 on Crunchyroll. 10-min mini-eps are friction-free bedtime bites.

new_this_week.title: Re:ZERO — Starting Life in Another World S4 Ep 10
new_this_week.format: Weekly (Wed 7am PT) — cour 1 of 19-ep S4; cour 2 starts 8/12
new_this_week.about: Subaru's Loss Arc winds down — cour 1 ends next week (Ep 11, 6/17).
new_this_week.why: You've been current with this; dark-fantasy isekai aligned with your sci-fi/fantasy core.

new_this_week.title: Re:ZERO S4 — Ep 11 (Cour 1 Finale)
new_this_week.about: Cour 1 wraps before the August return.
new_this_week.why: Banked for next Wednesday — clean stopping point if you want a mini-hiatus.

new_this_week.title: The Boroughs — full S1 (8 eps)
new_this_week.about: Critics-favorite sci-fi mystery you flagged 'watching' — full season is up for the rest of the run.
new_this_week.why: You already started this; staying with it is the easiest 1–2 hr/night.

new_this_week.title: Devil May Cry — S2
new_this_week.about: Adi Shankar's Netflix adaptation continues — Dante back in stylish-action mode.
new_this_week.why: Supernatural action with a snarky lead — landed on your prior rec list and still on Netflix this week.

new_this_week.title: Sugar — S2 (premieres next week)
new_this_week.about: Farrell's PI is back on a missing-persons case — and the alien-network angle is no longer the secret it was.
new_this_week.why: Noir + sci-fi twist + tight runtime. Heads-up to clear next Friday; alerts section has the date.

critics.title: Cape Fear
critics.about: Slow-burn psychological thriller reimagining of the Cady-vs-Bowden duel.
critics.why: Apple TV+'s biggest prestige play of the month; critics calling early eps 'a masterpiece.'

critics.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
critics.about: Quiet, lived-in adult anime that's pulling perfect-rating word-of-mouth.
critics.why: One of 2026's best-received anime so far — sets a Crunchyroll record at 5/5 with 14k ratings in three days.

critics.title: The Legend of Vox Machina — S4
critics.about: Critical Role's D&D-adjacent ensemble keeps the dry wit and high-stakes fantasy plotting.
critics.why: Critics calling S4 a return-to-form; strong taste-match overall.
